verdict.rationale: The only route out is indirect: VirtualPostMail advertises a Zapier integration ('connect your mail to 5000+ apps') and a direct API for 'full control of your workflow', which could plausibly move scans and metadata off the platform. No bulk export feature is documented, and probes found no public API spec (OpenAPI paths all 404), so even the API route is unverified. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of scan PDFs, export of mail-history metadata (e.g. CSV/JSON), API endpoint documentation for retrieving scans and history, and independent or hands-on confirmation that export works.
